summary: 99 tests passed (78 existing + 21 new), with the existing `test_capture.py::test_server_appends_each_decision_and_serves_static` deselected after its socket bind failed with `PermissionError: [Errno 1] Operation not permitted` in this sandbox. The full original 79 cannot be certified green here; no test or production server code was changed. All 148 strict decision cards passed offline DOM/image checks: exact reference CSS, self-contained valid PNGs, a full line and detector zoom, all three marked text rows, and stage/column/outcome pills. Sample detector rasters (L2 TP, L2 FP, multi-cluster D1 HOLD) were visually inspected. Browser layout QA could not run: Playwright bundled Chromium is absent, and launching the installed Chrome aborts under the sandbox. No install, external network request, CTC forward pass, label/instrument edit, git write, or other-worktree change was made. Protected old-engine sources and T1/old-validation inputs were checked byte-for-byte against HEAD; ignored test-instrument/cache files match the measurement receipt hashes. Per-word rows and sheets have one entry per strict decided word; ACCEPT and HOLD remain separate. L2 currently has two TP and two FP over the two seeds (one repeated TP and one repeated FP image); this measurement does not qualify L2 as a high-precision deployment default. The τῇ→τῆ false fire is `177b717d-p000067-l0009`: the detector reports no detached below blob and the classifier reads circumflex at tau. This is retained as a counterexample, with no held-out adjustment. Known human-text errors remain in literal precision scoring and are excluded only from T1 recall.
